_doc: Point-in-time retrospective. Every input was public on as_of; see sources. Hindsight lives only in outcome.json.
methodology: house v2 (EPP-distance adjustment), 6-section format; retro method r2: scenario inputs derived from dated facts by frozen rules (retro/README.md); defense prime contractor signals

pit_profile.why: 'In 2010, 84% of our $45.8 billion in net sales were made to the U.S. Government, either as a prime contractor or as a subcontractor.' (FY2010 10-K, Item 1); 'We depend heavily on U.S. Government contracts. A decline or reprioritization of funding in the U.S. defense budget, that of other customers, or delays in the budget process could adversely affect our ability to grow or maintain our sales, earnings, and cash flow.' (Item 1A): sales that depend on Congressional appropriations are not earnings that are the cycle, so DURABLE (the CAT and SO precedent); OFFSHORE (live from 2004-11-05) is scoped to offshore delivery taking share in Western consulting, systems integration and outsourcing, and the 10-K names no offshore competition, so no disruption theme in scope is live

classification.quality_note: 'In 2010, 84% of our $45.8 billion in net sales were made to the U.S. Government, either as a prime contractor or as a subcontractor.' A decline or reprioritization of funding in the U.S. defense budget, that of other customers, or delays in the budget process could adversely affect our ability to grow or maintain our sales, earnings, and cash flow.' (Item 1A): sales that depend on Congressional appropriations are not earnings that are the cycle, so DURABLE (the CAT and SO precedent); OFFSHORE (live from 2004-11-05) is scoped to offshore delivery taking share in Western consulting, systems integration and outsourcing, and the 10-K names no offshore competition, so no disruption theme in scope is live. durable franchise (obsolescence risk 2/5); price cheap; Ratio B 0.31x; +7% to EPP floor; model-vs-market gap -0.18; conservative 2yr +33%.

BEAR.desc: EPS -6.9%/yr (worst year FY03-FY10, capped at 0%); P/E to its 10th pct

BASE.desc: EPS +4.5%/yr (FY11 guide + margin + buyback); P/E at its 8.2-yr median

BULL.desc: EPS +17.4%/yr (FY03-FY10 CAGR); P/E holds its 75th pct

XBULL.desc: EPS +42.3%/yr (best 2-yr run FY03-FY10); P/E at its 90th pct

summary: LMT (retrospective, 2011-03-18) ◉ BUY — Ratio B 0.31x (26.7% downside to Bear $59 / +86.3% upside to Bull $150) | Adj composite 1.70 vs market 1.88: gap -0.18 [FAIRLY VALUED] | +7% above the EPP floor $75 (11x FY11E $6.85) | Conservative 2-yr case: +32.7% total (+16.3%/yr) | At 11.8x FY11E the 15% hurdle price $107 sits between the BASE and BULL cases; backlog +0.3% in Q4 2010, forward revenues -0.1% to +3.2% (FY11 net sales guide); OFFSHORE (live from 2004-11-05) is scoped to offshore delivery in Western consulting, systems integration and outsourcing, and the 10-Ks name no offshore competition; no theme in scope has dated evidence.
